narrative: A penny loaf on a wooden bread-board, short of an old knife-notch by a full thumb. Grey light from the kitchen window. A girl's hand at the edge of the board, reaching for nothing, not posed. No face.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Looked, and left the board as Alse had set it.

entities.name: the penny loaf
entities.context: In photo: The loaf and the notch
